title: repro instance_env keeps KB_ROOTS, so an orchestrator's external roots reach every instance session
goal: bench_repro.instance_env drops KB_ROOTS (and any other variable kbcommon reads to find roots outside the clone), so an instance sees only its clone's roots. Found by the SP-ygsnog4n review (S3).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import os;os.environ['KB_ROOTS']='/tmp/x';import bench_repro as b;sys.exit(1 if 'KB_ROOTS' in b.instance_env('/tmp/d',1) else 0)
